family: The single total input-modulus family F_n of proof.md Part I: F_n=0 for n<1024. Otherwise k is the least prime with k^5>32*n^3, m=n-k, r=ceil(m/k), t=ceil(sqrt(r)). The first k bits encode the lower coefficients of a monic degree-k polynomial q over F_2. Output 0 unless q divides T^(2^k)-T and gcd(q,T^2-T)=1. For a valid q, use K=F_2[T]/(q), zero-pad the m data bits into r polynomial-basis field blocks z_i, and output Tr_K/F_2(Sym_r^t(z_1^(2^(r+1)-1),z_2^(2^r-1),...,z_r^3)). The exact deterministic evaluator, including all encoding and validity tests, is given in proof.md.
theorem: For this one fixed total uniform polynomial-time family, hence in NP with empty witnesses, every full nonuniform B2 circuit at actual input length n has at least 4*n-65*n^(4/5) gates for every integer n>=16807. Consequently liminf over all integer n of C_B2(F_n)/n is at least 4.
